## HeuristicTablePluginConfig.growBeyondHeight property

When true, an explicit table `height` is treated as a minimum and the table grows to fit taller content. When false, the table keeps that height and scrolls vertically. Rows and cells always grow to fit their content; their declared heights are minimums in either mode.

**Signature:**

```typescript
growBeyondHeight?: boolean;
```

## Remarks

Per [CSS 2.1 §17.5.3](https://www.w3.org/TR/CSS21/tables.html#height-layout)<!-- -->, `height` on a `table`<!-- -->, `tr`<!-- -->, `th` or `td` box is only a minimum, so `true` is the faithful reading of the HTML. It is off by default to preserve the requested table viewport size while keeping all content accessible by scrolling.
